title: jmap: EventSource push (RFC 8620 §7.3)
description: Serve the Session's eventSourceUrl (RFC 8620 L695, §7.3: types, closeafter, ping; StateChange events) from the ChangeBus (.11.2), including membership-change signals (.12.34). Base draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 L1524 (cefc217): servers MUST support EventSource; EventSource only, no PushSubscription (.12.30). Until this lands, eventSourceUrl answers 404 (Limitation recorded by .11.2). Plan of mimid-1wgh.12 §6 ('.11.4 EventSource'; that number went to a decision). Needs .11.3.
